messages:
Ava: Morning triage — quick async snapshot. Current: 48 open tickets, 6 P1s (2 customer-impacting). Queue velocity +18% vs yesterday. Known issue: embeddings webhook failing on batched requests (502). Patch is on staging; short-term workaround = set batch_size=1 or route big jobs to the dedicated queue. Macros: 'refund-quick' updated to link new billing flow (PR below). I plan a canary deploy of macro-runner at 10:30 PT. https://github.com/redwood/support-macros/pull/78

Jess: Handled two billing escalations overnight — both had stale invoice IDs. Used the updated 'refund-quick' macro and left detailed notes. No blockers from my side. :white_check_mark:

Raj: Quick CR ping for @Lin on the macro template change — left comments on the PR, small variable mismatch. Will re-check after fix.

Lin: Looking now; spotted the variable bug (customer.name vs customer.display_name). Will push a tiny fix and add a unit test. Snippet of change:```
- {{customer.name}}
+ {{customer.display_name}}
```
Should have patch up in ~30m.

Sophie: Hit the embeddings webhook 502 this morning on a large batch. Short-term suggestion: route heavy embedding jobs to queue 'embed-d' until staging patch is verified. I created ticket SUP-2124 for follow-up and added logs to the runbook: http://runbook/embeddings-webhook

Morgan: FYI — two hosted customers reported inference latency spikes via support. I've escalated traces to eng-runtime and linked them in the incident thread. No immediate action from support unless eng asks for reproduction steps.

Ava: Action items: (1) @Raj merge macro PR after @Lin approves; (2) @Sophie open follow-up to add routing rule for large batch jobs; (3) Everyone tag tickets you touch with 'triage-sunrise' and note workaround applied. I'll kick off canary for macro-runner at 10:30 PT. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Macro runner v2.4.1 scheduled to deploy to canary at 2025-04-22T10:30:00-07:00 (canary size: 5 hosts).

Sophie: Created follow-up SUP-2125 to add routing rule, assigned to @Morgan.

Raj: Merged PR after Lin's tiny fix. :rocket:

Lin: Patch pushed in branch 'macro-template-fix' and PR merged. Adding tests to main CI job tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

Ava: Thanks team — last call for blockers before the sync at 11. If none, I'll start the canary. :coffee:
